rachel: Heads-up: found a parity+retry issue hitting the sample app. REST accepts `retry_policy: \"idempotent\"` and will retry on transient auth refreshes; our Go SDK only has `retry: true/false` and silently strips unknown fields. result: duplicate webhook deliveries when callers retry at the app layer.
lee: can you paste a tiny repro?
rachel: sure. REST vs Go SDK below. note the REST call gets a 202 then a retry after ephemeral refresh; SDK flow triggers an app-level retry and we end up double-delivering.
rachel: ```bash
# REST (respects retry_policy)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/send-webhook \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"url":"https://hooks.example/payload","payload":{"x":1},"retry_policy":"idempotent"}'

# Go SDK (drops retry_policy)
client.SendWebhook(ctx, SendWebhookOptions{
  URL: "https://hooks.example/payload",
  Payload: map[string]interface{}{"x":1},
  Retry: true, // SDK doesn't accept retry_policy string
})
```
ops-bot: quick log check for req `01ZXYZ99999`: SDK payload normalized to `{url, payload, retry:false}` in one observed run.
lee: hmm, dropping unknown fields silently is dangerous. we should at least warn in dev-mode or fail in strict mode.
rachel: also saw auth behavior: when ephemeral token refresh races we sometimes see 403 from the control plane (not 401). SDK treats 403 as terminal and does not trigger internal refresh+retry, so higher-level retry kicks in and duplicates side effects.
lee: two action items: (1) map `retry_policy` string -> SDK Retry behavior or expose the policy verbatim; (2) clarify retryable HTTP codes for ephemeral flows (403 vs 401) and update SDK docs/tests.
rachel: filed DEVEX-8123 with traces (req=01ZXYZ99999) and a short runbook. attaching sample logs.
devex-bot: Created task DEVEX-12567 from this thread and assigned to @lee.
lee: I'll add a small change: accept `retry_policy` in the Go SDK as an alias, emit a warning in non-prod, and add an integration test that compares SDK vs direct REST payloads. also will update retry semantics and add an e2e in the sampleapp to verify no double-posts.
rachel: thanks! long-term: we should consider generating SDK input validators from the OpenAPI spec so these name and enum drifts get caught in CI.
lee: +1. putting that on the SDK roadmap. :rocket:
